rv.q: The illusions provide useful punctuation or diversion when Helder and Catarina’s long trudge through the immigration process—and the discovery that, in showbiz, trickery of a less than benign kind can be a pitfall even among friends—becomes tangled.
My biggest question throughout was not the desired “how did he do that?” but rather “why does this objectively good trick not feel amazing?”

cn.t: Critics are divided on this magic show exploring American themes, with some finding it an overstuffed mix of spectacle and social commentary, while others praise its ambitious blend of illusion and ideas.

vr.q: if I'm going to watch a magic show, this is the kind of magic show I want to watch
